title: GPU procurement backlog & fulfillment playbook
content:
Purpose:
This note documents the current procurement backlog, expected fulfillment timeline, and operational playbook for getting GPUs from vendor commit to in-rack Ready state across regions. It is intended as a single-source working doc for infra, SRE, and finance to coordinate orders, deposits, shipping windows, and cross-team handoffs.

Scope and assumptions:
- Fleet SKUs in scope: H100-80GB (prod-heavy inference/llm), A100-40GB (mix of training+inference), L4-48GB (edge/low-cost inference).
- Numbers are forecasted against committed Dedicated capacity growth for FY25 Q2–Q4.
- Lead times reflect vendor estimates + historical shipping delays and customs windows.
- Contingency buffer target: 6% of core production fleet across regions, adjustable by tier.

Current backlog snapshot (as of 2025-02-28):
- H100-80GB: ordered 420 units, vendor ETAs dispersed across May–Oct 2025; remaining backlog after cancellations: 378 units.
- A100-40GB: ordered 260 units, partial deliveries ongoing; expected remaining: 92 units (Mar–Jun 2025).
- L4-48GB: opportunistic purchases, 180 units inbound in Mar–Apr 2025.

Summary table (text):
SKU | Ordered | In-transit | ETA range | Typical lead time (weeks)
H100-80GB | 420 | 42 | 2025-05 — 2025-10 | 18–28
A100-40GB | 260 | 120 | 2025-03 — 2025-06 | 8–16
L4-48GB  | 180 | 180 | 2025-03 — 2025-04 | 6–10

Pipeline stages (playbook):
1) RFQ & negotiation (procurement) — owner: Priya; artifacts: vendor RFQ sheet, signed MSA.
2) PO issuance & deposit — owner: Finance ops; note: stagger deposits to limit cash exposure per tranche.
3) Manufacturing allocation confirmation — owner: Vendor PM contact; confirm lot IDs and serial mapping.
4) Carrier booking & pickup — owner: Logistics; create ASN and tracking in procurement tracker.
5) Customs & import — owner: Global Ops; pre-clearance docs to be submitted 7 days before pickup into origin.
6) Regional staging (SFO/MUC/SIN) — owner: Regional infra leads; inspect, burn-in, assign tags.
7) Racking & commissioning — owner: SRE/Oncall provisioning; move to inventory and update capacity dashboard.

Notes on lead-time risk factors and mitigations:
- H100 allocation volatility: vendor may reassign capacity; mitigation: maintain top-of-book options with two vendors and secure engineering-forward slots (pay higher expedite fee).
- Customs slowdowns (APAC->EMEA): mitigation: route via alternate ports and prepay customs broker fees for priority clearance.
- Carrier container shortages: mitigation: split across carriers; accept LCL for partial shipments when schedule critical.

Regional buffer policy (recommended):
- Tier-1 region (SFO): target buffer = 8% of production pool, hold 14-day ready stock.
- Tier-2 region (MUC): target buffer = 6%.
- Tier-3 region (SIN): target buffer = 5% with capacity burst policy to fall back to hosted region.
Rationale: SFO drives 60% of low-latency traffic; higher buffer reduces production risk.

Utilization and provisioning alignment:
- Current running utilization across whole fleet: 72% tokenized (effective GPU-hours used / available).
- Target steady-state utilization: 78–82% to balance cost and cold-start risk.
- When util >85% for 3 consecutive weeks, trigger procurement acceleration play (escalation to exec ops).

Procurement cadence and tranche plan (recommended five tranches):
- Tranche 1 (Mar–Apr 2025): A100 catch-up + L4 full arrival. Goal: restore capacity for planned Dedicated launches.
- Tranche 2 (May–Jun 2025): First H100 shipment window (40% of H100 backlog).
- Tranche 3 (Jul–Aug 2025): H100 follow-on (30%).
- Tranche 4 (Sep–Oct 2025): Final H100 shipments + spare units.
- Tranche 5 (Q4 2025): Opportunistic top-up & replacement for decommissioned older cards.
Notes: each tranche has a P0 gating checklist (deposit settled, ASN verified, burn-in schedule, customs docs).

Operational checklists (per shipment):
- Pre-shipment: verify lot/serials in procurement tracker; confirm carrier and ETD; update finance with final invoice.
- At port: record container no., arrival window; pre-schedule customs broker; mark expected warehouse arrival.
- At staging site: run 6-hour burn-in with stress tests (latency tail and KV cache validation); create RMA ticket for any DOA >1%.
- Post-commissioning: tag to model pool, update capacity dashboard, notify product teams of available quota.

Exception flows:
- Partial shortfall from vendor (less than 50% of committed qty): convert remaining to expedited PO or reallocate from lower-priority regions.
- Complete cancellation: escalate to procurement lead + vendor legal for penalty clauses; open emergency spot market purchase cycle.

Cost and finance notes:
- Typical landed cost (example estimates): H100 ~ $16k/unit landed, A100 ~ $9k/unit, L4 ~ $4.2k/unit (varies by carrier and tariff).
- Budget cadence: finance requires final PO amounts at least 6 weeks prior to carrier booking for capital planning.

Open decisions / unresolved questions:
- Whether to increase Tier-1 buffer to 10% if Q3 demand projections increase after marketing campaign (deadline to decide: 2025-03-15).
- Confirm whether to prepay customs broker retainer for APAC shipments (finance approval pending).

Action items (owners and target dates):
- Priya: finalize tranche 1 PO schedule and deposit plan (due 2025-03-05).
- Marco: update procurement tracker with serial-level ASN mapping for A100 incoming shipment (due 2025-03-02).
- Aisha: run burn-in script validation and publish updated SRE checklist to Confluence (due 2025-03-04).
- Liam: run a short-term util stress test on dedicated pools to validate 85% trigger (due 2025-03-10).
